reviews.x: Seems to be made good and definitely removes the hair. My dog (long haired border collie) seems to love it as he kept coming back for more.
GREAT GLOVES for a RETIRED SOMEWHAT OVER WEIGHT KITTY!  (FLOWER) THINKS SHE'S GETTING EXTRA ATTENTION - SHE IS!  THANK UUUUU! ME-OOOOW WEEEEE!
I used these on my cat and it was amazing how much hair we got off the cat. They also worked really well on the microfiber couch too.
Arrived on expected date and works great. Prefect for my shedding French bulldog.

I rescued Lab husky mix a few months ago. I tried a brush and it did almost nothing on his hair. Got these gloves because I hear amazing things about them and they are fantastic. This is the amount of hair I pulled off my dog after a week's worth of daily brushing. A brush never came close to this. I would recommend these gloves for anybody who has a dog that sheds
They work great and I think  my dogs liked the wash/massage.
I liked the gloves and they came fast - I liked that too!

reviews.t: 5 Stars if it grabbed even more
reviews.x: Works - more fun than comb - easier for my daughter

reviews.t: extremely effective & both cats & dogs love them. perfect for grooming off the winter coat shedding
reviews.x: I gave the left hand to a friend with two dogs because she and her husband are left handed. they say their dogs love it and look forward to it and sometimes whine for it when they see it! my cat loves it, but my hands are a little small for them so I'd say anyone could use these gloves except for children (I have very small hands) but I still find a way to make it work because the wrist is slightly adjustable. they are easy to clean and gentle enough where my finicky cat (large siamese breed) lo

reviews.t: Great for pets who don't like traditional brushes
reviews.x: Our Labradoodle doesn't like traditional brushes, we have tried every kind. We needed a way to comb her in between grooming every month to prevent getting knotted coat. These gloves are perfect, we can pet comb her and she doesn't try to stop us. I was worried the little bristles wouldn't be long enough to comb her out properly but it does. Her groomer said her coat was in great condition when we took her in!

These definitely dislodge loose hair! I use my gloves on my 85# labradoodle and he loves them! He tries to bite brushes, but loves these gloves.  If only a little hair gets on the gloves, it can be hard to clean the gloves. The more hair on the gloves, the easier they are to clean.  Use them outside to keep your floor clean from fly away hairs.

reviews.t: Neither cat nor dog will tolerate
reviews.x: Previous pets thought these kind of gloves were fantastic, but my current pets want nothing to do with them. We dedicated one glove to each pet to make sure that wasn't an issue too. It just seems like they think it is too weird and won't sit still for it long enough to discover they like it. Too bad. I'll donate to an animal shelter.

I have a 1 yr old yellow lab who molts twice a year. I have a shedding attachment for my shopvac and along with these gloves it keeps the insane amount of shedding bearable. These gloves work great. Now my dog doesnt want me to stop using them because he thinks its petting time, he loves it. Cant beat the price too.

They won't pick up every hair, but they do catch a good bit. Worked on my dog, cat, and rabbit. The hair is a little hard to get off unless you have a massive amount of it on the gloves. Might take a little getting used to for your animal, the cat and rabbit were a little unsure of it the first try.

I purchased these to use on my ever shedding Husky. They help so much. They do remove a lot of fur. Plus, they're easy to clean. The only downside is that not all of it goes on the gloves. I would highly recommend using these outside unless you want to sweep/vacuum the pile of fur.

reviews.t: Good product- does what you would assume.
reviews.x: This is a pretty cool product. I used the gloves on my 3 short hair cats. A lot of fur was lifted and the cats loved being pet with the gloves on. The fur is easy to remove from the glove if there is a lot of fun on them... otherwise its a little annoying. Overall great product.

one size fits all makes your hand float inside the glove like throwing a wiener down the hall. If you managed to get some hair off your pet congratulations! it did what it was supposed to do, but now you have to try to get  the hair off the gloves :/ and it's a brutal task.

reviews.t: Definitely worth the money and get plenty of hair off dogs!
reviews.x: We are very pleased with the gloves. I was somewhat skeptical prior to ordering, but they work awesome! Although the glove states it’s one size fits all, they do fit both me and my husband just fine. I have smaller hands so they are definitely loose, but still work fine.

I use the mitten to brush my dachshund mix female.  She sheds a lot and you can even see the loose hairs.  Just got the glove yesterday but I believe that it will do the trick.  Can't beat the price and you get two gloves. I definitely recommend to other dog owners.

reviews.t: Hard to remove hair from glove :(
reviews.x: I have 2 white Pomeranian's and after seeing these I was so excited to try them. They work ok, but it's next to impossible to get their hair off the glove.  So bummed...thought I finally found the product that does what it said it would.

Works on my donkey, horse, goats and dogs. I’ve used on wet & dry fur. These supplement by grooming procedures and do not replace good brushes. every animal on y farm likes being brushed because it’s basically a massage.

I ordered these for my 86-year-old mother who was having trouble brushing her dog. He won't tolerate a regular wire dog brush. He tolerates these grooming gloves fairly well and my mom is comfortable using them.

reviews.t: Very Impressed with the pet grooming glove
reviews.x: This product works just as described. One of our dogs does not like being brushed and this glove works great. However it is a bit difficult to remove the hair from the glove, otherwise I'd give it 5 stars

reviews.t: Kind of do s the job
reviews.x: My cat hates being brushed. She liked this very much. It doesn’t collect much fur at all. And the gloves are huge. They slide all over even w the Velcro attached. I do not have dainty hands by any means.
The cats love being stroked with the grooming mittens. When you start stroking, they start purring and turn around after every stroke so they can get more on the other side!

claims.text: Most reviewers say the gloves effectively remove a lot of loose hair from dogs and cats, often more than a traditional brush.
Many reviewers report their pets enjoy the gloves, treating them like petting or a massage, and some pets come back for more.
Several reviewers find the gloves especially useful for pets that dislike traditional brushes.
Some reviewers note the hair can be hard to clean off the gloves unless there is a large amount of it.
A few reviewers mention their pets would not tolerate the gloves or were unsure of them at first.
